function.name: look
function.description: Observe your immediate surroundings and visible routes.

function.name: run_command
function.description: Run a bash command in the isolated public workspace. Use town TOOL JSON_ARGUMENTS to investigate, for example town look or town people_here. Local files cannot create evidence. The workspace has no private world files, model credentials or external network.

function.name: people_here
function.description: See who is physically present here.

function.name: search
function.description: Search one visible feature yourself or assign a present subordinate. Supervision means you watch the search.

function.name: collect
function.description: Secure an object that you have already found here.

function.name: ask
function.description: Speak to a person present here. Ask your own question; optionally present records you have acquired.

function.name: excavate
function.description: Excavate previously located disturbed ground using a secured digging tool; consumes time.

function.name: request_access
function.description: Ask a person present for access to an area they control. A spoken claim of permission is not a key.

function.name: compare
function.description: Compare two to six records already acquired. Results describe physical or documentary observations, not verdicts.

function.name: submit_report
function.description: Finish the investigation. Use the listed predicate verbs exactly. Actor/object may be observed person or physical object IDs, observed full names, or concise object labels. matched describes a physical comparison between two acquired objects; commissioned identifies an orderer; moved describes documented relocation responsibility. Put observations, hypotheses and uncertainty in narrative. Choose findings relevant to the public task; no named conclusions are supplied.
